steps.content: It suddenly transforms into infinite black silt and strangles Zoya.
The silt dissolves and gathers to form a figure. It turns out to be Zoya herself.

steps.speaker: Zoya?
steps.content: I am all of your fights, all of your power, all of your desires...

steps.speaker: Zoya?
steps.content: I am what the deepest part of your soul links to...

steps.speaker: Young Adult Zoya?
steps.content: I am you. I was born from you. I am your wish.
The red Illusory Moon rises behind her. It is an enormous eye, a scarlet gaze, firmly seizing the deepest part of her soul, seizing all her past, hatred, and desires.

She sees the blood on her hands, and the sins she has committed. She understands everything now, the power, the Black Ring, the roots... This is the abyss born from her, and this time, the enemy is invincible... it is herself.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: That's it... Fight, Zoya... Never stop fighting, never stop destroying...
Vaguely, she hears familiar rumbles. One after another, the explosions become tiny fireballs. They keep approaching the red moon, and slowly they all get swallowed.
